Zoe (CSM): quick flag ":small_red_triangle:" 12 mid-market accounts dipped in health after onboarding. want a compact save play focusing on unblock + low-friction concessions.
Kai (Support): which signals? errors or usage?
Zoe (CSM): combo: onboarding <60% AND 14d DAU drop >18%. renewals <80d escalate.
Ava (Enablement): propose: 30-min unblock workshop + 1-page playbook + 1-week office hours. cohorts of 6-8.
Rohan (AM): for renewal <60d prefer credit-based concession (seat credits or premium trial) over flat % off.
Kai (Support): Ill flag accounts with >2 setup tickets or repeat API errors for eng pairing.
Zoe (CSM): actionable steps: 1) export list (Rohan/SO) 2) outreach template & schedule (Ava) 3) triage & eng-pair (Kai) 4) concession proposal + downgrade-path (Rohan) 5) capture top_issue + verbatims (Zoe).
SyncBot: automated: 12 accounts flagged, avg_onboard 44%, avg_dau_delta -23%.
Ava (Enablement): outreach copy: "Hi <Name>, noticed setup stalled. 30-min unblock session + checklist at no charge this week. Want a slot?"
Rohan (AM): downgrade-path outline: preserve data, drop noncore features, min_seats 3, 45-day reupgrade_coupon.
Kai (Support): triage rule: if ticket_count>2 or error_tag=="integration_fail" -> eng_pair within 24h.
Zoe (CSM): owners & SLAs: export by today, outreach by EOD, workshops within 7d, eng-pair within 24h, concession within 48h post-workshop.
Ava (Enablement): :white_check_mark: building template and checklist.
Kai (Support): :white_check_mark: starting triage queue.
Rohan (AM): :white_check_mark: drafting concession templates.
Zoe (CSM): thanks team — drop any customer quotes in the export column "top_issue" so Product can act on quick fixes. Follow-up check-in tomorrow 9am PT.
